lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 812 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Mm hum.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And said that I was suppose to be home at ten.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Mm hum.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And she asked if I had a sweater on, which I did and then we waited for the fire to go down and then, by that time it was probably 9:30 and he says that I should go home early fer school the next day.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What about the truck? Her jeep?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He said that he would take care of it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: I think you helped him. Did you help him? If you did, it's OK.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, I helped him put the stuff in the jeep.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What stuff?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The knife and the gun.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Where'd you put the knife?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In the back.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: In the back where ah, the body was you mean or and the gun too?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you put them in there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he told me to.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did they get back in his house? You know?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well you told us that he took the license plates off. How did ya know that?
